# Targeting

- Choose a direct target by its visible name and add its numbered badge whenever the name is shared.
- Coordinate targets around the round objective: concentrated pressure can remove one threat sooner, while divided pressure can contest several urgent threats.
- Consider whether a target is visible, reachable, protected by terrain, already controlled, or central to the opposing group's plan.
- Do not assume an uncertain defeat or invent knowledge hidden by the tabletop presentation.
- Distinguish a creature target, an object target, and an area anchor. They are not interchangeable.

When several creatures share a name, the badge is part of the reference rather than descriptive prose.
